flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck OCMS)
code_summary: There is no Letter of Advice/warrant PDF generator, no UI to download/view such a PDF, and no vendor interface for LoA. The existing PDF + upload to Toppan pipeline is only for AN (Advisory Notice) letters and reminder/demand letters; Toppan upload is blocked by sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in the prod properties.
note: Status blank (requirement not given / status blank); traced normally. Follows OCMS27.21 (list after excluding settled/executed); that list does not exist, so the PDF has no input. No relevant maintenance ticket for LoA/warrant PDF (OCMS-SR-2026-041 is only an SMS alert for the Toppan Upload day-end job).
recommendation: Do not claim. The LoA PDF generator, UI view/download and vendor interface for LoA do not exist.

steps.step: Officer has excluded settled/executed cases from the Letter of Advice list
steps.detail: There is no LoA list nor a page to manage it; only an i18n menu label (translation.json:122-123) without a route in App.tsx. Searched synonyms warrant, letter of advice, LoA, arrest, execut*, mention, settle in the UI and API of all six repos: only an i18n menu label (ocmsadminui/src/i18n/en/translation.json:120-123), a TypeScript type ocmsadminui/src/utils/models/Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:1-12 and a notice search by warrant_no (ocmsadminui/src/pages/NoticeSearch/hook/useSearch.ts:68-78, endpoint warrantofarrest). The /v1/warrantofarrest endpoint is only listed in ocmsadminapi/src/main/resources/api-authorization.properties:23; there is no controller/entity/repository for it in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi, so cannot verify from repo whether an implementation exists elsewhere.

steps.step: OCMS generates a Letter of Advice/warrant of arrest PDF file from the list
steps.detail: There is no LoA template or generator. The only PDF generator (AnLetterPdfService.generateAnLetterPdf, using ocms_template_store + OpenHTML2PDF, :36) is specific to AN letters (OCMS 10) and is triggered from ToppanUploadJob.java:326, not from an LoA list, so it is not credited. Synonyms searched: warrant, letter of advice, LoA, pdf, template in both tiers.

steps.step: The PDF can be downloaded and viewed by users in the staff portal
steps.detail: There is no page or API to view/download an LoA PDF. /v1/download/blob and /v1/downloads exist in api-authorization.properties (OCMS_NOTICE_CREATE/DETAIL) but serve notice attachments, not an LoA PDF. Searched synonyms warrant, letter of advice, LoA, arrest, execut*, mention, settle in the UI and API of all six repos: only an i18n menu label (ocmsadminui/src/i18n/en/translation.json:120-123), a TypeScript type ocmsadminui/src/utils/models/Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:1-12 and a notice search by warrant_no (ocmsadminui/src/pages/NoticeSearch/hook/useSearch.ts:68-78, endpoint warrantofarrest). The /v1/warrantofarrest endpoint is only listed in ocmsadminapi/src/main/resources/api-authorization.properties:23; there is no controller/entity/repository for it in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi, so cannot verify from repo whether an implementation exists elsewhere.

steps.step: The PDF file is interfaced to the vendor for printing and postage
steps.detail: No vendor interface for LoA exists. The Toppan upload mechanism exists (AN letter PDFs are uploaded to blob in ToppanUploadJob.java:326-338, SFTP via ToppanUploadHelper) but it only processes reminder/demand/AN stages, not LoA, and Toppan SFTP is blocked by sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/resources/application-prod.properties:86); the real server value cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: Defendants are notified that warrants of arrest have been issued against them
steps.detail: No warrant notification/letter to defendants exists. The only notification path (NotificationSmsEmailJob) is limited to stages RD1/RD2/RR3/DN1/DN2/DR3 (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1114), not warrant stages.
